name: Golem
ability: You may only nominate once per game. When you do, if the nominee is not the Demon, they die.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned, the nominee does not die; the Golem has still used its one nomination.

rulings.text: If the Golem nominates a non-Demon, that player dies and the vote proceeds; if the nominee is the Demon, the vote proceeds with no explanation. Either way the Golem may not nominate again.
A Recluse registering as the Demon does not die.
If the Golem nominates by accident, the Storyteller may refuse the nomination, provided that does not reveal a Golem is in play.

test_scenarios.name: Kills non-Demon
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Golem, Bob Poppy Grower, Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob dies; voting proceeds; Alice gets Can not nominate.

test_scenarios.name: Nominates Demon
test_scenarios.expected: Nobody dies; the vote proceeds; Alice can no longer nominate.

test_scenarios.name: Recluse registers as Demon
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Golem, Bob Recluse (Storyteller registers him as the Demon), Carol Imp.

test_scenarios.name: Poisoned Golem
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Golem poisoned by Eve Poisoner, Bob Chef.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob survives; Alice still may not nominate again.

test_scenarios.name: Second nomination refused
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Golem who already nominated, Dave Chef.
